name: Fire Watch
tagline: Wildfire risk briefings for homes in Portugal
description: A fire analyst agent that checks satellite hotspots, official incident feeds, and fire weather against your address in Portugal — and answers plainly: threatened or not, what to do, and what would change the answer.

telegram.note: Access is personal and approved by the operator before any report runs.

footer.disclaimer: Fire Watch is informational tooling, not an emergency service. Official ANEPC / Civil Protection orders always override anything in a briefing. In an emergency, call 112.
footer.attribution: Data: IPMA · NASA FIRMS · fogos.pt · EFFIS · MeteoAlarm
